name: Molid
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Molid is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as part of the genealogy of the tribe of Judah. He was the son of Abishur and his wife Abihail. He is a lesser-known biblical figure with no recorded actions beyond his place in the genealogy.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Molid is mentioned as the son of Abishur and Abihail in the genealogy of Jerahmeel, a part of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Part of Jerahmeel's lineage
keyEvents.description: Molid belongs to Jerahmeel's branch of the tribe of Judah, an important lineage in Israel's history that was carefully documented in the Books of Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Hezron
keyEvents.description: Through his father Abishur, Molid can be traced back to Hezron, son of Perez, son of Judah—an important connection in the history of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogy of the Tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: Molid's place in the genealogical record underscores the importance of preserving tribal identity, especially for the tribe of Judah, which was the royal tribe of Israel.
